facts.fact: The article 'Gyms see New Year's rush' was published on January 2, 2026.
Gym member Scott Leannah says he has been working out at the Southwest YMCA in Greenfield, Wis. about five days a week for eight years.
facts.quote: He’s been coming here about five days a week for eight years now

facts.fact: Gym member Scott Leannah says gym crowds start to taper off within a matter of weeks and months after Jan. 1.
facts.quote: He said he notices how the crowds at the gym start to taper off within a matter of weeks and months after Jan. 1

facts.fact: Leannah says he has never regretted a morning workout, claiming he has never left one wishing he hadn't done it 100% of the time.
facts.quote: but 100% of the time I have never ever left after a morning workout wishing I hadn’t done it

facts.fact: Two Milligan University student cyclists, Haylan Engdahl and Brayden Rogers, were killed in a car crash in Hampton, Tennessee, on Wednesday, August 19, 2026.
facts.quote: student cyclists Haylan Engdahl, left, and Brayden Rogers, who were killed in a car crash in Hampton, Tenn., Wednesday, Aug. 19, 2026.

facts.fact: The headline reports that 7 college cyclists were injured in the Tennessee car crash.
facts.quote: 2 college cyclists killed and 7 injured in Tennessee car crash

facts.fact: Milligan University said 11 of its cyclists were out together on a morning training ride when they were struck by a driver in Hampton.
facts.quote: Milligan University said 11 of its cyclists were out together on a morning training ride when they were struck by a driver in Hampton.
